title: Hidden Checkout and CAPTCHA Safety

sections.name: Automatic checkout
items: The checkout and queue run with the task browser hidden; harvesters appear only for a detected CAPTCHA.
An ordinary reCAPTCHA badge no longer creates a false Needs You alert, and an actual embedded challenge is shown without reloading its live page.
Brava checks for order confirmation before looking for a post-submit CAPTCHA and never advances payment when required card controls are missing.
If the store rejects Place Order, task logs include the visible site error and warn you to verify the order before retrying.

sections.name: Known limitation
items: A generic Pokémon Center error after Place Order does not prove that the order failed. Check your email or account before another attempt.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
